indicator_name: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook crude prices, monthly history and forecast, USD per barrel
description: Цены на нефть по прогнозу EIA (Short-Term Energy Outlook), месячные: история и прогноз, $/баррель
methodology: Table 2 'Energy Prices' of the monthly STEO workbook; months after the release's last historical month carry transformation 'forecast'. The model takes the annual mean (annual: mean). STEO release: September 2026; last historical month 202608.
transformation: level (history) / forecast (months after the last historical month)
